message: We'd love to see a bulk export feature for our audit logs. We're a compliance-heavy org and this would save us hours every month.

classification.rationale: The message expresses a desire for a new feature to improve efficiency for a compliance-heavy organization.

enrichment.core_issue: The customer requests a bulk export feature for audit logs.

summary: The customer is requesting a bulk export feature for audit logs to save time in their compliance-heavy organization. This request indicates that multiple users would benefit from this feature.
